title: Harvard Square Bars and Late-Night Venues
snippet: Harvard Square has a modest but well-regarded selection of bars and live-music venues, most within walking distance of the T station.
full_text: Review aggregation for the Harvard Square area shows a modest but well-regarded selection of bars, pubs, and small live-music venues, most concentrated within a few blocks of the Red Line station. Nightlife is quieter than in Boston's downtown core but consistently rated well for atmosphere.
claim_text: Harvard Square has a modest, well-regarded selection of bars and live-music venues within walking distance of transit, though nightlife is quieter than downtown Boston.

title: Cambridge Venue Directory: Harvard Square
snippet: Listings show a cluster of bars, pubs, and a comedy club within the Harvard Square business district.
full_text: The Cambridge Events Directory lists a cluster of bars, pubs, and a comedy club within the Harvard Square business district, several of which host regular live music or trivia nights popular with the local student population.
claim_text: Harvard Square has a modest, well-regarded selection of bars and live-music venues within walking distance of transit, though nightlife is quieter than downtown Boston.
